label: Measured on SUN RGB-D val; parameters chosen here are frozen for Phase 05

rules.r5: min oracle median 3D error over valid, valid fraction >= 0.6 at n_min 20 / tau_cov 0.3 / tau_spread 0.25; ties within 5 mm -> A, then larger shrink
